item.title: ANOTR & 54 Ultra’s ‘Talk to You’ Tallies Fourth Week at No. 1 on WARM Global Dance Radio Chart
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music update. We're taking a look at the top tracks on the WARM Global Dance Radio chart. And for the fourth week in a row, ANOTR's 'Talk to You' featuring 54 Ultra is holding strong at number one."
[Short music clip of "Talk to You" plays]
Host: "This Amsterdam-based electronic duo has been making waves on TikTok, with their song featured in over 60,000 videos. And it's not just on social media - 'Talk to You' has also become a hit on Billboard's US-based charts, reaching number 5 on Hot Dance/Electronic Songs and currently sitting at number 14."
[Short music clip transitions to host]
Host: "But 'Talk to You' isn't the only song making moves on the chart. Bebe Rexha and Faithless' 'New Religion' is holding steady at number 2, while Calvin Harris and Kasabian's 'Release the Pressure' is at number 3. And FISHER and Tones and I's 'Favour' is rising to number 5 with a 14% gain in plays."
[Short music clip of "Favour" plays]
Host: "We're also seeing some new entries on the chart. Max Styler, Vintage Culture, and Ali Love's 'Freaky 1' debuts at number 39, and John Summit's 'Shades of Blue' enters at number 42."
[Short music clip transitions to host]
Host: "The WARM Global Dance Radio chart is a great way to see what's trending globally in dance music. It aggregates plays from over 200 dance-dedicated radio stations across more than 30 countries. You can check out the full top 40 on Billboard.com and head to WARM's website for the full 100-position survey."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to this music update. We'll catch you on the next one."
